rows.text: Norges Bank’s Executive Board decided today to reduce the key policy rate by 0.50 percentage point to 1.75 per cent.
Norges Bank’s Executive Board decided today to reduce the key policy rate by 0.50 percentage point to 1.75 per cent.
“The turbulence in financial markets has intensified and external growth is now expected to be clearly weaker, particularly in the euro area.

In order to dampen the impact on the Norwegian economy, the Executive Board has decided to lower the key policy rate”, says Deputy Governor Jan F. Qvigstad.
